question: An AI agent keeps getting stuck in a loop: it calls the same tool over and over without making progress toward the goal. In one short sentence, name the single best way to detect and stop this. Answer with just the approach itself, concisely.

attempts.reasoning: The AI agent's repeated calls to the same tool indicate a loop, so tracking tool usage frequency can detect this behavior. Limiting the number of consecutive tool calls prevents infinite loops and ensures progress toward the goal.

The AI agent's repeated use of the same tool without progress indicates a loop. Monitoring tool invocation frequency can detect this pattern. Limiting the number of consecutive identical tool calls would prevent infinite loops.

attempts.answer: Detect repeated tool calls within a timeframe.
